title: Quick Velvety Peruvian Sweet Potatoes Picarones
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring sweet potatoes, garlic, and anise, cooked to a velvety texture in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and nostalgic, this dish is perfect for a snack or dessert. The sweet potatoes and anise provide a delicious and comforting flavor combination.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
In a blender or food processor, combine the sweet potatoes, garlic, anise seeds, and brown sugar, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, flour, and water.
Add the sweet potato mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in the preheated ttukbaegi earthenware pot.
Using a spoon, drop the sweet potato mixture into the oil and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the picarones from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle the picarones with salt and serve warm.
